messages:
Yara Mendes: Quick kickoff for CloudMarket co-announcement + live demo on 11/02. Partner wants a single global broadcast with two brief regional breakouts. Need owners for announcement copy, demo handoff, rehearsal, and swag return directives.

Kelvin Ortiz: I can take announcement copy + partner approvals. Timeline idea: draft by 10/24, partner review 10/26, final sign 10/29. Does that work?

Sofia Park: Works for marketing. Also need to collect short speaker bios (<=60 words) and headshots (square). Can we get those by 10/25?

Andre Silva: I'll own the demo flow + fallback. Plan: main 20m live demo, then two 10m regional breakouts (APAC/EMEA) where local partners run a quick hands-on. We'll have a 4-min pre-recorded fallback.

Maya (events): Registration form will capture name, email, timezone, and a "ship swag" opt-in. Legal reminded to only ship to opt-ins and to purge addresses after 90 days.

Yara Mendes: Swag: Redwood sends sticker pack + postcard, partner sends a small sample. Shipping windows: US by 10/30, EU/APAC by 10/31. @ShipBot any customs flags?

ShipBot: Reminder: include HS codes and commercial invoice. Suggested declared values: sticker pack $1.75, postcard $0.50. Undelivered items held 21 days then returned.

Kelvin Ortiz: For the announcement, partner asked for an embargo until 11/02 12:00 PT. We'll need a 48h review window. Also include a co-branded hero image.

Sofia Park: I'll request headshots and bios today. Also ask speakers for pronouns and social handles for the marketplace card.

Andre Silva: Demo runbook highlights:
- T-15: confirm stream + captions
- T-5: health check to hosted endpoint
- live handoff: switch to partner sandbox for regional breakouts
- rollback: play pre-recorded fallback video + update chat banner
Code snippet for runbook:
```
# switch to hosted for handoff
export REDWOOD_KEY=${REDACTED}
redwood-cli demo --endpoint https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate --model redwood-prod
```

Maya (events): AV notes: enable live captions, record with captions, and prepare a short banner that indicates fallback is playing if triggered. Rehearsal windows: 10/29 11:00 PT (full run), 11/01 09:00 PT (tech check).

Yara Mendes: Legal: ensure partner claims vetted. We won't allow comparative benchmark numbers without legal signoff. Kelvin, loop legal in for the announcement copy.

Kelvin Ortiz: Will do. Final owners: Kelvin (announce copy & partner approvals), Andre (demo + fallback), Sofia (speakers & marketplace assets), Maya (registration + AV + swag logistics), ShipBot (tracking customs). Reconvene 10/26 for partner review pass. :white_check_mark:
